periods.title: Payroll Periods
periods.subtitle: Opened payroll periods and their status.
periods.empty: No payroll period has been opened yet.

emptyState.title: No payroll period yet
emptyState.description: A period has to be opened before payroll can be calculated. Before opening it, employees' payroll parameters (wage basis, SGK status, meal/transport) must be defined on the employee card > Payroll tab; employees without parameters or salary are not calculated.

openDialog.title: Open payroll period
openDialog.error: The period could not be opened.

adjustments.title: Extra earnings
adjustments.subtitle: Bonus, commission and performance payments are entered gross, added to the same month's payroll and subject to SGK and tax. They only change while the period is open.
adjustments.empty: No extra earnings in this period.
adjustments.name: Name
adjustments.error: The action could not be completed.
adjustments.isNetHint: If checked, the employee keeps exactly this amount; the gross is calculated in payroll.

preview.title: Trial payroll
preview.subtitle: Calculates the period exactly like the real run but saves nothing, so you can review totals and net pay before generating payslips.
preview.skipped: {{count}} employees could not be calculated (missing profile or salary).

skipReasons.wage_basis_mismatch: The payroll profile wage basis does not match the salary record pay frequency
skipReasons.net_wage_basis_unsupported: Daily/hourly employees with a net wage cannot be calculated yet; enter a gross wage
skipReasons.pay_item_formula_failed: A pay item formula could not be evaluated (for example a division by zero); check the formula and the assigned value
skipReasons.incentive_parameter_missing: A legislation parameter an incentive definition refers to could not be found (or is not a valid rate); check the incentive definition and the legislation parameters

receiptMatching.title: Receipt matching
receiptMatching.subtitle: Upload the bank's return file (generic CSV - IBAN, amount, optional status column); matching payments are marked confirmed, differences are only reported, never changed.
receiptMatching.error: The receipts could not be matched.
receiptMatching.unrecognized: {{count}} unmatched rows in the file were skipped.

comparison.title: Comparison with the previous month
comparison.noPrevious: No payroll period for {{period}}; the comparison is empty.
comparison.exceeding: {{count}} row(s) exceed the threshold or are new/gone.

closing.title: Closing checklist
closing.subtitle: Track preparation, calculation, legal and archive steps before approving the period. The period cannot be approved while blocking items are open.
closing.error: The action could not be completed.

items.HIRE_NOTICES: New-hire notices checked on the SGK e-Bildirge
items.EXIT_NOTICES: Exit notices processed; exit reason and notice/severance calculation checked
items.CAREER_CHANGES: Transfers, promotions and title changes updated
items.CONTRACT_RENEWALS: Contract renewal and extension decisions checked
items.LEAVE_USAGE: Annual, unpaid and excused leave usage checked
items.SICKNESS_REPORTS: Sick days queried from SGK e-Rapor; incapacity benefit days recorded
items.OVERTIME_APPROVED: Overtime and weekly rest-day work approved
items.BONUSES_COLLECTED: Bonus, commission and performance payments collected
items.BES_VERIFIED: Private pension (BES) deductions, new participants and withdrawal periods checked
items.BENEFITS_PROCESSED: Meal card, transport and social benefits processed
items.LEGISLATION_PARAMETERS: Statutory parameters for the period are defined (tax brackets, SGK ceiling/floor, stamp tax)
items.PAYSLIPS_GENERATED: Payroll has been calculated for the period
items.NO_DIRTY_PAYSLIPS: No changed payslip is left uncalculated
items.NET_NOT_NEGATIVE: No payslip with a negative net or zero gross
items.EMPLOYEES_WITHOUT_PAYSLIP: No active employee is left without a payslip (net-salary or salary-less employees are skipped)
items.PARAMETERS_VERIFIED: Minimum wage, SGK and tax parameters verified; incentive codes and terms checked
items.PREVIOUS_MONTH_COMPARISON: Comparison with the previous month done
items.VARIANCE_REVIEWED: Items deviating more than 5% from last month reviewed
items.SAMPLE_NET_CHECK: Net pay of 10 randomly chosen employees checked
items.PROFILE_CALC_CHECK: Manual gross-to-net done for at least 3 profiles (minimum, mid, high income); bracket crossing checked
items.FINANCE_APPROVAL: Finance/accounting approval obtained (senior management if required)
items.RECONCILIATION_DONE: Reconciliation of total gross, SGK, income tax and net payment completed
items.APHB_PREPARED: Monthly Premium and Service Document (APHB) prepared
items.APHB_SENT: APHB sent via e-Bildirge; entry/exit notices checked
items.MUHSGK_PREPARED: MUHSGK declaration prepared; income and stamp tax verified
items.SGK_PAYMENT: SGK premium payment verified and payment order created
items.BANK_TOTALS_MATCH: Bank payment amounts compared with the payroll total
items.BES_INSTRUCTION_SENT: BES payment instruction sent to the bank
items.GARNISHMENT_TRANSFERRED: Garnishment amounts transferred to the relevant accounts
items.CHANGE_LOG_CREATED: Payroll change log created (headcount, total cost)
items.MANAGEMENT_REPORTS: Management reports prepared (staff cost, department split, overtime, cumulative comparison)

warnings.pay_item_negative_result: A pay item formula came out negative and was set to 0
warnings.pay_item_duplicate_assignment: The same pay item is assigned more than once for the month; only the latest-starting assignment was paid
warnings.incentive_not_approved: The incentive definition assigned to the employee is not approved by the SMMM; it was left out of the calculation

payItems.title: Pay item types
payItems.subtitle: Define formula-based earnings (allowances, bonuses, etc.); once assigned to employees they are added to payroll.
payItems.empty: No pay items defined yet. Start with "New pay item" by defining a code, a name and a formula; then you can assign it to employees.
payItems.genericError: Pay items could not be loaded.

form.codeHint: Starts with an uppercase letter; letters, digits and underscore (2-32 characters). Cannot be changed later.
form.codeLocked: The code cannot be changed after creation.
form.name: Name
form.directionHint: Only earnings can be defined for now; deductions are not supported yet.
form.netFlagsLocked: Net items are fully taxable; the flags are locked.
form.defaultValueHint: Used for "deger" in the formula when no value is entered at assignment.
form.error: The pay item could not be saved.

formula.label: Formula
formula.hint: E.g. brut * 0.10 or eger(kidem_yili >= 5; deger; 0). Decimal separator is a dot, argument separator ; or ,.
formula.validateError: The formula could not be validated.

variables.brut: Base gross pay (prorated; excludes overtime and other items)
variables.net_hedef: Agreed net salary (0 for gross-paid staff)
variables.kidem_yili: Years of service (full years from hire to period end)
variables.deger: Value entered at assignment (default value if none)

assignments.title: Pay item assignments
assignments.subtitle: Formula pay items effective in this period. While the period is open you can add assignments, change their value or end month, or delete them.
assignments.employeeEmpty: No pay item is assigned to this employee.
assignments.empty: No pay item is assigned for this period.

modal.title: Assign pay item
modal.noEmployees: No employee selected yet; you can add several employees.
modal.tooMany: At most {{max}} employees can be assigned at once.
modal.valueHint: If empty, the pay item's default value is used.
modal.valueDefault: If empty, the default value ({{value}}) is used.
modal.toMonthHint: Empty = open-ended; same month as the start for a one-off.

payItemLines.title: Calculated pay item lines
payItemLines.subtitle: Earning lines produced by formulas in the period's latest calculation.
payItemLines.empty: No calculated pay item lines for this period (not calculated yet, or nothing assigned).

loadErrors.formulaCatalog: The formula catalog could not be loaded; variables and functions cannot be listed.
loadErrors.payItemLines: Calculated pay item lines could not be loaded.

incentives.title: Incentives
incentives.subtitle: Tenant-specific incentive models: employer SGK discount, premium coverage, income tax relief and declaration-code only. Only definitions approved by the accountant/expert enter the calculation.
incentives.empty: No incentive is defined yet. Start from a ready draft with "Add from template" or create your own with "New incentive".
incentives.genericError: Incentive definitions could not be loaded.

kindHint.employerSgkRateDiscount: The employer SGK premium is reduced by the rate applied to the SGK base.
kindHint.employerShareCoverage: The state covers a share of the premium items you select (employer/employee SGK and unemployment).
kindHint.incomeTaxWithholdingRelief: A share of the income tax withheld (after exemptions) is relieved; the employee's net does not change, the employer cost drops.
kindHint.declarationOnly: Only the incentive law code is written to the declaration; the calculation is unchanged.

form.codeHint: Upper-case letters, digits and underscore (e.g. SGK_6111_DRAFT); cannot be changed later.
form.codeLocked: The code cannot be changed once created.
form.name: Name
form.declarationCodeHint: Digits only (up to 10), e.g. 05510. Required to assign SGK-category incentives.
form.declarationCodeInvalid: The declaration code must contain digits only (up to 10).
form.kindLockHint: The category (SGK vs. tax) of an incentive that has assignments cannot be changed.
form.keyNotInForce: This key does not appear to be in force today; it is verified on approval.
form.catalogError: The legislation parameter catalog could not be loaded.
form.capMultiplierHint: The base is capped at the minimum wage times this multiplier (0-10).
form.employerSgkRateHint: The rate used to compute the employer SGK share to be covered.
form.declarationOnlyHint: This type has no calculation parameters; only the declaration code is used.
form.maxMonthsHint: If set, an end month is required on assignment and the total months per employee cannot exceed it.
form.validFromHint: Assignments only count from this date. Today if empty.
form.draftHint: You can save an incomplete draft; completeness is only checked on approval.
form.approvalWillDrop: This definition is approved. Changing a calculation field (type, parameters, declaration code, months, dates) will drop the approval and the definition stays out of the calculation until it is approved again.
form.error: The incentive could not be saved.

approveModal.disclaimer: This approval is a declaration by the accountant/expert. The correctness of the rates and scope is your responsibility; the system does not check legal compliance. Who approved, when and the note are recorded.
approveModal.revokeHint: Once revoked, the definition stays out of the calculation until it is approved again (the declaration code is still written).
approveModal.incompleteHint: This draft has missing fields; the server will name the missing field on approval.
approveModal.noteHint: Optional (up to 500 characters), e.g. a reference to the advisor's opinion.
approveModal.approveError: The approval could not be given.
approveModal.revokeError: The approval could not be revoked.

templates.title: Add incentive from template
templates.intro: Ready templates are copied to your tenant. Rates come empty (only 5510 comes approved, with the existing behavior); you enter the real rates with accountant/expert approval.
templates.addError: The template could not be added.
templates.validFromNote: The added definition is valid from today; edit its start date if you will assign it to earlier months.
